answer: Every fresh alias dilutes the cluster's average standing, so the larger the flock the weaker each individual vote becomes — coordination requires many low-weight votes that cancel each other out. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. Consider a nadir as the anchor of the cost.
